subject: Hosting activation playbook and MAP — deployment mode & region decision
messages:
From: Emma Walsh <emma@medsprint.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — evaluation & region requirements

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We have a narrow window to land a deployment decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and confirm region for data residency. Procurement and engineering need a clear MAP and evaluation timeline to present to the execs.

Top constraints: EU data residency (GDPR), p95 inference latency target ~200ms for conversation flows, and the ability to validate KV cache behavior with our 3-second session windows. Security packet attached (MedSprint-Security-Reqs.pdf) — procurement will expect answers on key management and audit logging.

Can you share a proposed mutual action plan with concrete milestones, owners, and a pilot approach that lets us evaluate tradeoffs quickly? Ideally we want a decision by Oct 8 so contracts can move through our legal queue.

Cheers,
Emma Walsh
Director of Product
MedSprint Health

Attachment: MedSprint-Security-Reqs.pdf (application/pdf, 234KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Next steps — evaluation & region requirements

Hi Emma — great to meet you and thanks for the clear constraints. I sketched a short MAP below that balances speed and risk and will let you validate each milestone. I put owners on each line so procurement/engineering know who to pull in.

Redwood proposed MAP — MedSprint Health (summary)
1) Kickoff & acceptance criteria (by Sept 29) — Owner: camila_reyes
   - Confirm success metrics: p95 latency < 200ms, throughput 200 reqs/sec, correct KV cache behavior
2) Hosted pilot (2 business days setup, 7 business days run) — Owner: camila_reyes
   - Purpose: fast-path functional validation in EU-west region using Redwood hosted endpoints
   - Data handling: no long-term storage, telemetry available for audit
3) Dedicated pilot (if Hosted shows performance/cost risk) — Owner: karthik_iyer
   - 3-day provisioning window for a small dedicated GPU pool in eu-west, validate autoscale & sustained throughput
4) Private/VPC evaluation (only if residency/legal require) — Owner: ben_carter
   - Scope: KMS integration, audit logs, air-gapped packaging estimate
5) Decision & contract terms (target Oct 8) — Owner: procurement@medsprint.com + camila_reyes

Deliverables and artifacts
- Redwood MAP doc (sheet) — redwood-map-template.xlsx (attached)
- Pilot test plan + obs dashboard access
- Cost estimate for Dedicated + uplift for Private (karthik will provide)

Next steps for us:
- I’ll spin up the Hosted pilot in eu-west on Sept 29 and share credentials and a small test harness.
- Karthik, can you run a quick capacity estimate for 200 reqs/sec with our q4 pricing and attach a ballpark?
- Ben, can you list the KMS and logging artifacts procurement will need for Private?

If that timeline looks good I’ll add everything to the HubSpot deal and share a MAP link.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0198

Date: 2026-09-28T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Next steps — evaluation & region requirements

Camila —

Quick capacity & pricing note (ballpark, will refine):
- For 200 rps conversational workload with p95 <200ms in eu-west on a small Dedicated pool (4x A100-equivalent), expect sustained token throughput around ~80k tokens/min. Estimated monthly committed spend: ~$14k–18k depending on sustained concurrency and KV cache hit rate.
- Hosted pilot will give us real telemetry to tune batching and KV caching; recommend we instrument prefix caching and run parallel runs to compare unit costs.

On Private: procurement will ask for HSM/KMS references and an SSO onboarding checklist. Ben — can you draft a one-pager with the items and an estimate for the integration effort?

I’m happy to provision the Dedicated PoC if we get the green light after Hosted run; timeline ~72 hours to get a minimal pool live in eu-west. I’ll attach the initial capacity csv.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Camila / Karthik —

This looks good and aligned with our constraints. We want to prioritize EU residency, so Hosted pilot in eu-west is the right fast-path. If the Hosted telemetry shows either latency or cost issues we’ll move to a Dedicated pilot.

Procurement note: our legal team needs the KMS approach and whether audit logs can be shipped to our log collector (Splunk). Also please confirm expected contract start date if we choose Dedicated: earliest Nov 1.

Decision timeline: we’ll complete the Hosted pilot by Oct 6 and expect a go/no-go by Oct 8. Procurement will start an internal PO request on Oct 9 if all looks good.

Thanks — Emma
